name: deepseek-v4.1-flash
_comment: OpenCode Go model (https://opencode.ai/v2/docs/console/go): model id deepseek-v4.1-flash, priced off-peak $0.15 input / $0.60 output and peak $0.30 / $1.20 per 1M tokens (peak hours 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC on weekdays). Same model as DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on api.deepseek.com: 1M context, 384K max output, vision input, thinking on by default (DeepSeek `thinking` object, sent by the OpenCode DeepSeek dialect). Off-peak/peak billing doubles during peak hours.
